people.name: Job
people.line: A righteous man who endured great suffering

translations.web: Yahweh turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.
translations.bsb: After Job had prayed for his friends, the LORD restored his prosperity and doubled his former possessions.
translations.kjv: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much
translations.asv: And Jehovah turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: and Jehovah gave Job twice as much as he had before.
